messages:
maria_g: Heads up — seeing a surge of fncall validation rejects in eu-west over the last 20m. ~4% of requests now. error=invalid_tool_response

ian_k: Oof. Any common pattern in the payloads?

maria_g: quick grep shows a lot of responses with top-level array instead of object. Example from logs: 
```
tool_response: [ { \"result\": \"ok\" } ]
expected: { \"result\": string, \"meta\": object? }
```

sophia: That matches the schema gate we rolled out yesterday (strict_validate=true for fncall). Did we enable sampling=100% for canary?

ian_k: Canary was supposed to be 10%. Looks like the rollout script bumped it to 100% in eu-west by mistake (bad regex in rollout YAML).

deploy-bot: deploy: rollout/validator-strict mode updated to 100% in eu-west by @ops. Commit: 8f3a2b.

nate_r: If we flip back to soft mode can we avoid billing regressions? What about metric continuity?

maria_g: Soft mode would coerce arrays->objects via adapter and increment fncall.soft_coercions.count. That keeps client UX intact and avoids rejects, but it hides some bad integrations.

ian_k: For short term we should: 1) revert canary to 10%, 2) enable soft-validate=true in eu-west, 3) create a dashboard tile for fncall.rejects vs fncall.soft_coercions.

sophia: Agree. Also we need a sampling alert for abrupt jumps in rejects as a safety net. Rule: alert if rate increases >0.5% absolute within 5m and overall >1%.

maria_g: I can revert the rollout and set soft-validate. Doing it now.

deploy-bot: action: rollback rollout/validator-strict -> target_percentage=10%. by @maria_g.

maria_g: Done. Also toggled soft_validate=true for eu-west: `/config/validators/fncall/eu-west.json` now has \"mode\": \"soft\"

ian_k: Nice. Can you paste the query we should add to the dashboard?

maria_g: Sure — PromQL to track side-by-side: 
```
sum by (region) (rate(fncall_validate_rejects_total[5m]))
sum by (region) (rate(fncall_soft_coercions_total[5m]))
```

sophia: Add a ratio panel too: `reject_rate = rejects / (rejects + success + soft_coerce)` — so we don't miss volume changes.

nate_r: Who owns follow-up? We should reach out to integration owners whose traffic triggered coercions. Maybe add a honeytoken to surface the most common caller_ids.

maria_g: I'll file a short ops ticket with sample traces and top caller_ids. I'll also add an annotation on the console dashboard at the rollback time.

ian_k: One more ask — update docs for tool-adapters section to call out that validators accept arrays only when soft_validate is enabled. Put sample adapter snippet.

sophia: I'll handle the docs PR.

maria_g: TL;DR: accidental full rollout triggered rejects; rolled back to 10%; enabled soft-validate in eu-west; added dashboard queries and alert; filing ticket to contact integrators.

nate_r: Thanks all. Follow-up sync if we see the metric not dropping in 10m. :thumbsup:
